description:
Underground Transfer Hub for Tram and Rail

One station, up to four levels deep, rail and tram in any mix.

Build an underground interchange where every level points its own way. Change it later without tearing it down.

What it does

  • One to four stacked levels. Each level has two tracks.
  • Rail or tram on every level. Mix them as you like. Levels 2 to 4 can also be switched off.
  • Own angle and length for every level. The angle runs from 0° to 180° in steps of 5°. The platforms are 40, 80, 120, 160, 240 or 320 m long.
  • Passenger, cargo or mixed operation. Cargo and mixed operation add a depot beside the entrance.
  • Track type and catenary for the rail levels: simple, standard or high-speed track.
  • Change it after construction. Open the settings of the built station and change any value.
  • Stairs between neighbouring levels. Passengers change from one level to the next through a round hall, without the walk back up.

How to use it

  • Open Rail, Buildings or Road, Buildings and pick the Underground Transfer Hub.
  • Set the levels in the settings window and place the station next to a street.
  • Connect your tracks and tram tunnels to the free ends of each level.

Good to know

  • The price grows with the number of levels. Cargo and mixed operation cost a quarter more. The length of a level does not change the price.
  • Connected levels are locked. A level with tracks attached cannot change by mistake. The settings show a note for it.
  • The texts are available in the 13 languages of the game, with the game's own words.
  • Removing the mod from a saved game that holds a hub breaks that saved game.

Credits

  • This mod is built on https://mod.io/g/transportfever3/m/simple-metro-transfer-station1, with the kind permission of its author, Mal7hael. The design of the levels, the platform strips and the cargo depot come from that mod.
  • The hall, the entrance building, the hedge and the tram tunnel are files of Transport Fever 3, changed for this mod.
  • I used AI as my development assistant, and it did all the graphics and translation work too. :)
name: Underground Transfer Hub for Tram and Rail
summary: Underground station with up to 4 stacked levels, rail or tram, each with its own angle and length.
